'''Kristiansund BK''' is a Norwegian professional [[football (soccer)|football]] club located in [[Kristiansund]] that currently plays in [[Eliteserien]]. The team plays its home matches in the 4,444-capacity [[Kristiansund Stadion]].

Kristiansund BK was formed in the autumn of 2003, when two rival clubs of Kristiansund, [[Kristiansund FK]] and [[Clausenengen FK]], agreed to establish a new elite team."}}
